races.paceDynamic: Fandabidozi will take the field along from the front with Casual Encounter likely to track close behind, but neither are strong pace-setters which creates a moderate gallop over this staying trip. The majority field consists of hold-up horses (Rubellite, Havachoc, Fine Print, Apache Eagle, Lamlash) who will be looking to pick up the pieces in the straight. With only two prominent runners and five confirmed hold-up horses, this sets up as a tactical affair that should develop into a sprint finish. This race shape strongly favours the hold-up horses who can close late when the pace inevitably quickens.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays moderate throughout and becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The prominent runners Fandabidozi and Casual Encounter set insufficient pace over 1m6f, allowing the hold-up brigade to close with powerful late runs. Rubellite and Havachoc have the highest ratings and proven form at this trip to capitalize.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tactical Battle Unfolds
scenarios.trigger: If both prominent runners hesitate and create a crawling pace
scenarios.body: The race becomes a stop-start affair with no genuine pace-setter taking responsibility, leading to an even more tactical finish. Apache Eagle's recent placed form and Fine Print's headgear change could see them respond better to the waiting tactics.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Escapes
scenarios.trigger: If Fandabidozi gets an uncontested lead and maintains a steady rhythm
scenarios.body: Despite the long absence, the 8-year-old veteran uses experience to dictate terms from the front while the hold-up horses leave their run too late. Casual Encounter could benefit from tracking the winner throughout the race.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Stamina Test Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely strong throughout
scenarios.body: The 1m6f trip becomes a true test of stamina rather than a sprint finish, but this seems unlikely given the field composition. Only Rubellite has consistently performed well at extended distances to handle such conditions.

scenarios.body: The race becomes messy with multiple hold-up horses getting in each other's way, allowing a patient finisher to come with one late run. Kakirra or Al Amirah could benefit from the chaos despite lower ratings.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Winner Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the favourites falter and an outsider capitalises

races.paceDynamic: Lightkiss will take the field along from the front with no other confirmed pace-setters in this small field of six fillies. scenarios.label: A

scenarios.trigger: If Lightkiss sets an uncontested lead and the pace stays moderate throughout
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get their ideal scenario with a sprint finish, allowing the highest-rated and most talented fillies to showcase their class. Bintwafaa's OR 120 rating and Withtearsinmyeyes' recent second-place form make them ideally suited.

scenarios.trigger: If the slow pace leaves multiple horses with finishing chances but they all flatten out
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace means no horse gets into a proper rhythm, leading to a messy finish where stamina becomes more important than class. The Gosden-trained Seet and consistent Silver Lake benefit from their patient tactics.

scenarios.body: The slow pace and sprint finish creates an upset opportunity for a horse whose form figures don't reflect their tactical ability. Sapphire Secret overcomes her fading tendency or the pace suits an overlooked runner.
